listDesc: Opening quantity, stock in, stock out and closing balance per product, for all warehouses together or one warehouse. Download as Excel or PDF.
title: Warehouse inventory statement
subtitle: Per product: opening quantity, what came in, what went out and the book balance for the period.
invalidRange: The start date must not be after the end date.
noWarehouse: You are not assigned to any warehouse yet.
allNote: The downloads contain the combined statement first, then one statement per warehouse.

notes.formula: Book Balance = Period Start Qty + Inbound − Outbound. Inventory Variance = Physical Count − Book Balance.
notes.physical: Physical Count is left empty: fill it in the Excel file (the variance is calculated for you) or write it on the printed PDF during the stock-take.
notes.vehicle: From Vehicle / To Vehicle = stock received from / sent to another warehouse or vehicle (transfers).
notes.other: Other In. / Other Out. include stock adjustments and expired write-offs.
